items.source: Get the Document representation of the filter to apply. The returned Document is used directly with the driver without further type or field mapping.
items.translation: 获取要应用的过滤器的 Document 表示形式。返回的 Document 将直接与驱动程序配合使用，无需进行进一步的类型或字段映射。

items.source: Get the Document representation of the filter to apply.

items.source: A filter to specify which elements to modify in an array field.
items.translation: 用于指定要修改的数组字段中哪些元素的过滤器。
